name: Arcane Retribution
body:
School transmutation [fire]; Level sorcerer/wizard 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 action
Components V, S, M (pinch of ash from a cremated spellcaster)

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Area 30-ft. radius spread
Duration concentration +1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Fortitude half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

Any arcane spellcaster casting a spell within this spell’s area of effect suffers 1d6 points of fire damage per spell level. Spells of 0 level cause only 1 point of fire damage. This spell does not affect divine spellcasters.
